summary: Westport Fuel Systems Inc., an Alberta-incorporated Nasdaq-listed engine technology company, entered a common share purchase agreement and registration rights agreement with Roth Principal Investments, LLC on September 15, 2026, creating a US$25,000,000 committed equity facility. The company may sell up to 12,690,355 shares at its sole discretion over a 36-month commitment period via market-open, intraday, pre-market and post-market purchases, subject to a US$1.00 threshold price and per-purchase caps of 2,000,000 shares or 25% of Nasdaq volume, mapped to a US equity line of credit. Watch dilution pace and registration effectiveness.
